tools.name: callout_create_call
tools.description: Places a real outbound phone call through Callout's voice agent and returns a call_id at once; the call itself runs in the background and is billed to the signed-in Callout account. Destinations: numbers in Japan, the US and Canada. A call lasts up to 4 minutes (one credit); max_duration_seconds up

tools.name: callout_get_call_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a Callout call: queued (not dialed yet), initiated, ringing, in-progress (answered), or once it has ended Twilio's final status (completed, no-answer, busy, failed, canceled).

tools.name: callout_wait_for_call_completion
tools.description: Waits until a call reaches a final status or the timeout is reached, and returns the status. Calls usually take 1 to 3 minutes.

tools.name: callout_get_call_result
tools.description: The structured result of a completed call. outcome is one of ok (someone answered and the conversation took place, whatever came of it: read summary), needs_human (the other side will only deal with the user, or the matter needs the user's decision), needs_website (they said it must be done online),

tools.name: callout_get_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript of a completed call.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "callout_create_call" is 1054 chars, far longer than this server's median (201). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
